title.narrative: Global Partnership for Output Based Aid (GPOBA) Department for International Development (DFID) (Phase 2) Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"The main objectives are mainstreaming and implementing OBA by Governments and Development Agencies as a key mechanism for improving the lives of poor people by facilitating their access to affordable infrastructure services.
The priority countries for subsidies will be in Sub-Saharan Africa and Asia with DFID's continued support in infrastructure services in mature sectors such as energy and water & sanitationcomma as well as less mature ones such as public transportcomma solid waste and irrigation. DFID funds have to be used at least 60% on Low Income Countries (LIC) and 40% in Middle Income Countries (MIC)."
